review.rationale: Primary review of all 68 entries from the official UNL ECE faculty-staff page and the UNL campus directory for the department (people on both lists merged by name, with seven documented spelling aliases), reconciled with a full-roster independent Haiku audit. 29 regular ECE professors and one courtesy associate professor are included; emeriti, research roles, staff, adjuncts, practice-track professors and an affiliate with no rank are excluded. One remaining duplicate pair (Choobineh) is emeritus under both spellings, so no count is affected.
